name: File Safety Guard
description: Blocks AI agent writes to sensitive files: SSH credentials, shell configs (.bashrc/.zshrc), cloud credentials (.aws, .kube, .gnupg, .azure), system files (/etc/sudoers, /etc/passwd), and device paths. Ported from hermes tools/file_operations.py WRITE_DENIED_PATHS.

additionalDeniedPaths.description: Additional exact file paths to deny writes to (~ is expanded)

additionalDeniedPrefixes.description: Additional directory prefixes whose entire subtrees are write-protected
